import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

plan_path = Path('results/training/qwen38_seed1_plan.json')
plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
path = Path('results/training/qwen38_seed1_batch.json')
assert not path.exists(), 'Inspect the existing receipt before any restart'
source = Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_seed1/grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py')
assert file_sha256(source) == plan['replication_source_sha256']
assert plan['metadata']['is_private']
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'run the preregistered validation-only seed replication'},plan['provenance']['model_revision']),
          'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'plan_sha256':file_sha256(plan_path),
          'metadata':plan['metadata'],'source_sha256':file_sha256(source),
          'status':'waiting_for_primary_running','polls':[]}

def save():
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')

save()
while True:
    primary = json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_round3_batch.json').read_text())
    polls = primary['polls']
    if polls and 'KernelWorkerStatus.RUNNING' in polls[-1]['output']:
        break
    if primary['status'] in ('outputs_retrieved','output_pull_failed','push_requires_inspection'):
        record['status']='not_submitted_primary_requires_inspection'
        save()
        raise SystemExit(0)
    time.sleep(10)
env={**os.environ,'KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR':str(Path('runs/kaggle_oauth_config').resolve())}
for name in ('KAGGLE_KEY','KAGGLE_API_TOKEN','KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE'):
    env.pop(name,None)
subprocess.run(['/Users/nico/.local/share/uv/tools/kaggle/bin/python','scripts/kaggle_quota.py'],env=env,check=True)
snapshot=json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text())
quota=snapshot['quota']
available=quota['gpu_seconds_total']-quota['gpu_seconds_used']-quota['gpu_seconds_reserved']
record.update(quota_snapshot=snapshot,available_seconds=available)
if available < 63000:
    record['status']='not_submitted_insufficient_quota_with_primary_evaluation_reserve'
    save()
    raise SystemExit(0)
assert file_sha256(source)==plan['replication_source_sha256']
record.update(status='submitting',submitted_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
save()
result=subprocess.run(plan['training_command'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
record['push']={'command':plan['training_command'],'exit_code':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout,'error':result.stderr}
match=re.search(r'Kernel version (\d+)',result.stdout)
record.update(status='submitted' if result.returncode==0 and match else 'push_requires_inspection',version=int(match[1]) if match else None)
save()
assert record['status']=='submitted','Inspect the result; do not retry an ambiguous submission'
ledger_path=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger=json.loads(ledger_path.read_text())
ledger['sessions'].append({'kernel':plan['metadata']['id'],'version':record['version'],'accelerator':'T4 x2 requested',
    'start':None,'end':None,'hours':None,'submitted_at':record['submitted_at'],'private':True,'status':'submitted',
    'source_commit':plan['source_commit'],'receipt':str(path),'session_timeout_seconds':41400,
    'purpose':'Independent seed-1 replication of the exact Qwen3.8-27B SFT/GRPO recipe; validation only, no seed promotion to primary test.',
    'hours_basis':'Pending downloaded runtime and official account debit; session cap is not measured usage.'})
ledger_path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Submitted private replication version',record['version'],flush=True)
subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python','-u','scripts/watch_kaggle.py','--receipt',str(path),
                '--out',f"results/kaggle/qwen38-seed1-training-v{record['version']}"],check=True)
